# Notes

# Code

## Pre-amble

### Run pre-amble script

```{r}

# Source parameters, functions and install packages
if (!require(here)) { install.packages("here") }
here::i_am("10_finalModel.qmd")
source(here::here("utilities", "R", "codeModules", "boilerPlate", "loadParamsLibrariesFunctions.R"))

# Source grid search parameters
source(here::here("params", "biomarkerParams_gridSearch.R"))

```

### Load data

#### Abundance data

```{r}

# Read in cyclic Loess-normalised data
quantTable_allSamples <- read.table(here::here(diaDir, "normalised", 
                                    "metaCrossSectional_NormalyzerDE_byCondition", "CycLoess-normalized.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)

# Chosen imputed data
quantTable_chosenMethod <- read.table(here::here(impDir, paste0("quantTable_imputedWithbPCA.tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)

# Match metadata
trainMetaData <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers",
                                       "allSamplesMetadata_takenForSelection.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

# Get common
quantTable <- quantTable_allSamples[,trainMetaData$Sample_ID]

# Keep only selected metadata
quantTable <- quantTable[,!grepl("QC",colnames(quantTable))]
quantTable_noMissing <- quantTable[!is.na(rowSums(quantTable)),]

```

#### Metadata

```{r}

# Metadata
source(here::here("utilities", "R", "codeModules", "data", "readMetadata_filtered.R"))

# Get relevant samples
metaCrossSectional_child <- metaCrossSectional[metaCrossSectional$Age_Group == "Child",]
metaCrossSectional_noJIA <- metaCrossSectional_child[!metaCrossSectional_child$Condition %in% c("JIA"),]

# Get test data
testMetaData <- metaCrossSectional_noJIA[!metaCrossSectional_noJIA$Sample_ID %in% trainMetaData$Sample_ID,]

# Add years
addMetaCross_child["Years"] <- ( max(as.numeric(ymd(addMetaCross_child$Date.of.sample)), na.rm=TRUE) - as.numeric(ymd(addMetaCross_child$Date.of.sample)) ) / 365 

```

```{r}
source(here::here("params", "colors.R"))
```

### Read in proteim data

```{r}

# Read in filtered proteins from differential abundance
protSets <- readRDS(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "differentialAbundance", 
                               paste0("chosenProteins_featureSelection_pThr0.05_treatLog2Thr0.rds")))

```

### Get final models

```{r}

# Read in desired proteins
finalTargets <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "modelComparison",
                                      "finalProteinList_biModal_multiGroupModels.tsv"), header=TRUE)

# Get protein lists
chosenProtsBim <- finalTargets[finalTargets$Model == "BiModal" | finalTargets$Model == "Both",]$Protein
chosenProtsGrp <- finalTargets[finalTargets$Model == "MultiGroup" | finalTargets$Model == "Both",]$Protein

# Get all proteins
allChosenProts <- finalTargets$Protein

```

### Modelling with rmcorr to account for condition correlations

#### Read in metadata with date as numeric

```{r}

# Read in data
dateMetaData <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "samplesWithDate", 
                           paste0("trainData_justChildSamples_samplesWithDate_splitProp",trainSplitProp,"_allSites.tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

# Add scaled abundance
dateMetaData <- merge(dateMetaData,
                      t(quantTable_chosenMethod[finalTargets$Protein,]), 
                      by.x="Sample_ID", by.y="row.names")

# Loop over proteins
for (i in seq_along(finalTargets$Protein)) {
  
  # Scale protein abundance data
  dateMetaData[paste0("Z_",finalTargets$Protein[[i]])] <- scale(as.numeric(dateMetaData[[finalTargets$Protein[[i]]]]),
                                                                center=TRUE,
                                                                scale=TRUE)
  
}

```

#### Read in DE protein set and compare to final targets

```{r}

# Add if unimputed
finalTargets["ImputedInDiscovery"] <- "No"
finalTargets[is.na(rowSums(quantTable_allSamples[finalTargets$Protein,trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),]["ImputedInDiscovery"] <- "Yes"

# Add if in date adjusted set
sort(intersect(chosenProtsBim, protSets$limma$padj$DresdenOnly_withDate))
sort(intersect(chosenProtsGrp, protSets$limma$padj$DresdenOnly_withDate))
finalTargets["inDateAdjustedSet"] <- "No"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% 
                     protSets$limma$padj$DresdenOnly_withDate),]["inDateAdjustedSet"] <- "Yes"

# Add if in date adjusted set
sort(intersect(chosenProtsBim, protSets$limma$padj$AllSite))
sort(intersect(chosenProtsGrp, protSets$limma$padj$AllSite))
finalTargets["inSiteAsPredictorSet"] <- "No"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% 
                     protSets$limma$padj$AllSite),]["inSiteAsPredictorSet"] <- "Yes"

# Add if in PW comparisons between Dresden conditions and 
sort(intersect(chosenProtsBim, protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_infOsteoHealthyPW))
sort(intersect(chosenProtsGrp, protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_infOsteoHealthyPW))
finalTargets["inPWvsInfOsteoHealthy"] <- "No"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% 
                     protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_infOsteoHealthyPW),]["inPWvsInfOsteoHealthy"] <- "Yes"

# Add if in PW comparisons between Dresden conditions and 
sort(intersect(chosenProtsBim, protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_allPW))
sort(intersect(chosenProtsGrp, protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_allPW))
finalTargets["inPWvsAllConditions"] <- "No"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% 
                     protSets$limma$padj$Dresden_allPW),]["inPWvsAllConditions"] <- "Yes"

# Read in differential abundance data
discoSiteDiffData <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "differentialAbundance",
                                "limmaResults_ANOVA_wrtCNOvContrasts_crossSectionalData_justDresdenSamples.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

# Add significance in dresden set
finalTargets <- merge(finalTargets,
                      discoSiteDiffData[,c("PG_ID","adj.P.Val")],
                      by.x="Protein",
                      by.y="PG_ID")

# If consiidering adults
if (!excludeAdultSamples) {
  
  # Check if in adult set
  finalTargets["inAdultSet"] <- "No"
  finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% 
                     protSets$limma$padj$AdultProteins),]["inAdultSet"] <- "Yes"

}

# Get date proteins
dateProts <- finalTargets[finalTargets$inDateAdjustedSet == "Yes",]$Protein

```

```{r}
# Depleted prots
depletedProtData <- read.table(here::here(baseDataDir, "annotation", "depletedProteinSet.txt"), sep="\t", header=FALSE)
depletedProts <- depletedProtData$V2

```

### Filter final targets

```{r}

# Drop depleted protein
stopifnot("There are still depleted proteins in multiGroup model-selected proteins"=!any(depletedProts %in% chosenProtsBim),
          "There are still depleted proteins in the Multi-Group model-selected proteins"=!any(depletedProts %in% chosenProtsGrp))

```

```{r}
# Create output
dir.create(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel"), showWarnings=FALSE)

```

### Split with final proteins

```{r}

# Make sure condition is character
trainMetaData$Condition <- as.character(trainMetaData$Condition)
rownames(trainMetaData) <- trainMetaData$Sample_ID

# Split data train/test
groupSplits <- splitOverIters(trainMetaData, 
                              quantTable_chosenMethod[chosenProtsGrp,
                                                      trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                              "Condition", 
                              splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                              nIters=nIters, 
                              method="Random", 
                              considerGroup=FALSE)
biModalSplits <- splitOverIters(trainMetaData, 
                                quantTable_chosenMethod[chosenProtsBim,
                                                        trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                                "BiModal",
                                splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                                nIters=nIters, 
                                method="Random", 
                                considerGroup=FALSE)
biModalSplits_grpProts <- splitOverIters(trainMetaData, 
                                         quantTable_chosenMethod[allChosenProts,
                                                                 trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                                         "BiModal",
                                         splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                                         nIters=nIters, 
                                         method="Random", 
                                         considerGroup=FALSE)

```

### If under-sampling

```{r}

if (!is.null(nUnderSamples)) {
  
  biModalSplits <- splitOverIters(trainMetaData, 
                                  quantTable_chosenMethod[chosenProtsBim,
                                                         trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                                "BiModal",
                                splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                                nIters=nIters, 
                                method="Random", 
                                considerGroup=FALSE,
                                underSampleN=nUnderSamples)
  
}

```

### Tune models

#### Get baseline

```{r}

# If tune parameters
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {

  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  # Calculate metrics
  bimMetrics_unTuned <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal,
                                            splitData=biModalSplits,
                                            metaData=trainMetaData,
                                            multiGroup=FALSE,
                                            predCol="BiModal")
  grpMetrics_unTuned <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_multiGrp,
                                            splitData=groupSplits,
                                            metaData=trainMetaData,
                                            multiGroup=TRUE,
                                            predCol="Condition")
  bimMetrics_grpProts_unTuned <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal_grpProts,
                                                     splitData=biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                     metaData=trainMetaData,
                                                     multiGroup=FALSE,
                                                     predCol="BiModal")

}

```

See: https://www.tmwr.org/tuning

#### Bi-Modal

Reading in the object can be quite taxing, so just read in, plot, get best model and remove

```{r, fig.width=28, fig.height=14}

# If tune parameters
if (tuneModelParams) {

  # Set file
  saveFile <- here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel",
                         "lassoRes_biModal_modelTuning.rds")

  # if it exists
  if (file.exists(saveFile) & !reGenerateFiles) {

    # Read in from file
    gc()
    lassoResTune_biModal <- readRDS(saveFile)
    gc()

  # Else run
  } else {

    # Tune models
    gc()
    lassoResTune_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                          metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                          functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                          thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                          runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                          covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                          posCase = "CNO",
                                                                                          nRFTrees = nRFTrees,
                                                                                          maxDepths = maxDepths,
                                                                                          minNodeSize = minNodeSize,
                                                                                          sampleFrac = sampleFrac,
                                                                                          paramStepSize = stepSizeParams,
                                                                                          numRandomSplits = numRandomSplits,
                                                                                          splitRule = splitRule,
                                                                                          nrounds = 100,
                                                                                          tuneParams = TRUE))

    # Save
    gc()
    saveRDS(lassoResTune_biModal, saveFile)
    gc()

  }

  # Get best models
  bestModel_biModal <- getBestModel(modelFits=lassoResTune_biModal,
                                    metaData=trainMetaData,
                                    baseLine=bimMetrics_unTuned,
                                    chosenConditions="CNO")

  # Set file
  saveFile <- here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel",
                         "lassoRes_biModal_optimalTunedModel_byAUC.tsv")
  write.table(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams,
              saveFile,
              sep="\t",
              row.names=FALSE,
              quote=FALSE)

  # Set file
  saveFile <- here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel",
                         "lassoRes_biModal_allModelData_byAUC.tsv")
  write.table(bestModel_biModal$PlotData,
              saveFile,
              sep="\t",
              row.names=FALSE,
              quote=FALSE)

  # Remove large object
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal)
  gc()

}

```

### Fit final models

```{r}

# If tune parameters
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {
  
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                    splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                    min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                    max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                    mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                     splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                     max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                     mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                             num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                             splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                             min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                             max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                             mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                         floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                         bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  # Remove tuned
  gc()
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal)
  rm(lassoResTune_multiGrp)
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal_grpProts)
  gc()
  
# Else use chosen/default parameters
} else {
  
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))

}
```

#### Add if found in validation

```{r}

# Get variable importance
finalTargets <- finalTargets[order(finalTargets$MultiModalVarImp, 
                                   decreasing=TRUE),]

# If file exists
validAbundFile <- here::here(validDir, "DIAProteomics", "directDIA_spectronautProcessed", "filtered",
                             paste0("filtered_unNormalised_validationData_maxMissing",maxPropMissing,".tsv"))
if (file.exists(validAbundFile)) {
  
  # ReaD in validation
  validM <- read.table(validAbundFile,
                       sep="\t", header=TRUE)
  
  # Add if detected in validation dir
  rownames(finalTargets) <- finalTargets$Protein
  finalTargets["InValidation"] <- "No"
  finalTargets[intersect(finalTargets$Protein, rownames(validM)),]["InValidation"] <- "Yes"
  
}
```

#### PPCA

```{r}

# Fit probabilistic PCA
set.seed(35353)
selectProtPPCA <- pcaMethods::pca(t(quantTable_allSamples[chosenProtsBim,trainMetaData$Sample_ID]), 
                                  method="ppca", center=TRUE, scale="pareto", cv="q2", nPcs=10)

# Combine with metadata
selectProtPPCA_metaData <- merge(trainMetaData, scores(selectProtPPCA), by.x="Sample_ID", "row.names")

# Get variance explained
varExpl_child <- list(variance.percent=(sDev(selectProtPPCA) / sum(sDev(selectProtPPCA)))  * 100)

# Set factors as categorical/numeric
selectProtPPCA_metaData$COLUMN <- as.character(selectProtPPCA_metaData$COLUMN)
  
# Loop over PCs
## All together
maxPCs <- ifelse((length(chosenProtsBim)-1) >= 3, 3, (length(chosenProtsBim)-1))
for (i in seq_len(maxPCs)) {
    
    # Plot
    # Technical
    plate_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPPCA_metaData, var=varExpl_child, color_by="PLATE", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=12) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=plateCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=48),
            legend.title=element_text(size=52),
            legend.text=element_text(size=42),
            axis.title=element_text(size=80),
            plot.title=element_text(size=96)) +
      labs(fill="Plate") # +
      # ggtitle("Child Samples\n(Selected Proteins)") +
      # guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    site_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPPCA_metaData, var=varExpl_child, color_by="Site", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=12) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 24)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=siteCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=48),
            legend.title=element_text(size=52),
            legend.text=element_text(size=42),
            axis.title=element_text(size=80),
            plot.title=element_text(size=96)) +
      labs(fill="Site") # +
      # ggtitle("Child Samples\n(Selected Proteins)") +
      # guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    
    ## Biological
    condSite_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPPCA_metaData, var=varExpl_child, 
                              shape_by="Site", color_by="Condition", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=12) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 22, 25)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=tidyCondCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=48),
            legend.title=element_text(size=88),
            legend.text=element_text(size=64),
            axis.title=element_text(size=104),
            plot.title=element_text(size=116)) +
      labs(shape="Site") # +
      # ggtitle("Child Samples\n(Selected Proteins)") +
      # guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    cond_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPPCA_metaData, var=varExpl_child, 
                              color_by="Condition", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=12) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=tidyCondCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=48),
            legend.title=element_text(size=88),
            legend.text=element_text(size=64),
            axis.title=element_text(size=104),
            plot.title=element_text(size=116)) +
      labs(shape="Site") # +
      # ggtitle("Child Samples\n(Selected Proteins)") +

    sex_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPPCA_metaData, var=varExpl_child, color_by="Sex", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=12) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=sexCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=48),
            legend.title=element_text(size=88),
            legend.text=element_text(size=64),
            axis.title=element_text(size=104),
            plot.title=element_text(size=116)) 
      # ggtitle("Child Samples\n(Selected Proteins)") +

    ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", "PPCA",

    ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", "PPCA",

           condSite_plt, width=10000, height=7500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", "PPCA", 
                      paste0("PC",i,"to",i+1,"_colByCond_facetBySite_justSelectedProteins_biModalModel.png")), 
           condSite_plt + facet_wrap(~Site, ncol=2), width=6000, height=7500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", "PPCA", 
                      paste0("PC",i,"to",i+1,"_colBySex_justSelectedProteins_biModalModel.png")), 
           sex_plt, width=10000, height=7500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", "PPCA", 
                      paste0("PC",i,"to",i+1,"_colByAge_justSelectedProteins_biModalModel.png")), 
           age_plt, width=10000, height=7500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    
}
```

```{r}
# Fit probabilistic PCA
set.seed(35353)
```
```{r}
selectProtPPCA <- pcaMethods::pca(t(quantTable_allSamples[intersect(dateProts, chosenProtsBim), trainMetaData$Sample_ID]), 
                                  method="ppca", center=TRUE, scale="pareto", cv="q2", nPcs=10)

# Combine with metadata
```

##### Calculate model metrics

```{r}

# Calculate metrics
bimMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal,
                                  splitData=biModalSplits,
                                  metaData=trainMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=FALSE,
                                  predCol="BiModal")
grpMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_multiGrp,
                                  splitData=groupSplits,
                                  metaData=trainMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=TRUE,
                                  predCol="Condition")
bimMetrics_grpProts <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal_grpProts,
                                           splitData=biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                           metaData=trainMetaData,
                                           multiGroup=FALSE,
                                           predCol="BiModal")
bimMetrics["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics))
grpMetrics["Split"] <- rep(seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics)),
                           length(unique(grpMetrics$Group)))
bimMetrics_grpProts["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics_grpProts))

# Make tall
bimMetricsTall <- melt(bimMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
grpMetricsTall <- melt(grpMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
bimMetrics_grpProtsTall <- melt(bimMetrics_grpProts,
                                id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))

# Remove NPV/PPV
bimMetricsTall <- bimMetricsTall[!bimMetricsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]
grpMetricsTall <- grpMetricsTall[!grpMetricsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]
bimMetrics_grpProtsTall <- bimMetrics_grpProtsTall[!bimMetrics_grpProtsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]

```

##### Plot

```{r}

plotModelMetrics <- function(plotData,
                             cols) {

  # Get plots
  plt <- ggplot(plotData,
         aes(x=Group,
             y=value,
             color=Group)) + 
    stat_summary(fun = "median", 
                 fun.min = "median", 
                 fun.max = "median", 
                 color = "black",
                 size= 0.8, 
                 geom = "crossbar",
                 inherit.aes=TRUE,
                 show.legend=FALSE) + # position=position_jitterdodge()
    geom_jitter(size=6,
                height = 0,
                alpha=0.4,
                width=0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values=cols) +
    facet_grid(cols=vars(variable)) +
    ylab("Score") + 
    xlab("") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                       limits=c(-0.05, 1.05)) +
    theme_classic(base_size=16) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
  
  # Return
  return(plt)
  
}

        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),

  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                           override.aes = list(size = 25)))
p3 <- plotModelMetrics(plotData=bimMetrics_grpProtsTall,
```

#### Shuffle labels

```{r}

# Shuffle data
shuffSplits_bim <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=biModalSplits, 
                                          metaData=trainMetaData,
                                          selectProts=chosenProtsBim,
                                          responseVar="BiModal",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                      floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                      bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                          num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=groupSplits, 
                                          metaData=trainMetaData,
                                          selectProts=chosenProtsGrp,
                                          responseVar="Condition",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                          num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplit=biModalSplits_grpProts, 
                                                     metaData=trainMetaData,
                                                     selectProts=allChosenProts,
                                                     responseVar="BiModal",
                                                     nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                                     num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                     splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                     max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                     mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                 floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                 bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                     covs2Include=covs2Select)

# Combine
shuffSplitMetrics_bim <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_bim),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_bim[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_bim[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))
shuffSplitMetrics_grp <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_grp[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))

# Add actual performance
shuffSplitMetrics_bim <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplitMetrics_bim, 
                                        id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))
shuffSplitMetrics_grp <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplitMetrics_grp, 
                                        id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther, 
                                             id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))

# Fix variables
shuffSplitMetrics <- rbind(cbind(Set="Bi-Modal", 
                                 shuffSplitMetrics_bim),
                           cbind(Set="Multi-Modal", 
                                 shuffSplitMetrics_grp),
                           cbind(Set="Bi-Modal (Whole Panel)", 
                                 shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther))

# Tidy names
shuffSplitMetrics["variable"] <- gsub("[.]", " ", shuffSplitMetrics$variable)
```

```{r}
                                                                                    max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                    mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     metaData=trainMetaData,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                     splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                     max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                     mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             metaData=trainMetaData,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,

                                                                                             min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                             max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                             mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                           floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                           bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  # Remove tuned
  gc()
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal)
  rm(lassoResTune_multiGrp)
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal_grpProts)
  gc()
  
# Else use chosen/default parameters
} else {
  
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
```

```{r}
# Scale

quantTableTest_scaled <- apply(quantTable_chosenMethod[,testMetaData$Sample_ID], 2, scale, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE)

rownames(quantTableTest_scaled) <- rownames(quantTable_chosenMethod)
```

#### Shuffle labels

```{r}

# Shuffle data
shuffSplits_bim <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=biModal_testData, 
                                          metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                          selectProts=chosenProtsBim,
                                          responseVar="BiModal",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                      floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                      bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                          num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=mGroup_testData, 
                                          metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                          selectProts=chosenProtsGrp,
                                          responseVar="Condition",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                          num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplit=biModalGrpProts_testData, 
                                                     metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                                     selectProts=allChosenProts,
                                                     responseVar="BiModal",
                                                     nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                                     mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                 floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                 bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                     num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                     splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                     max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                     covs2Include=covs2Select)

# Combine
shuffSplitMetrics_bim <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_bim),
```

```{r}

# Scale
quantTableTrain_scaled <- apply(quantTable_chosenMethod[,trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 2, scale, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE)

rownames(quantTableTrain_scaled) <- rownames(quantTable_chosenMethod)
rownames(quantTableTest_scaled) <- rownames(quantTable_chosenMethod)

# Create to match the data splits above
biModal_testData <- list(list(train=t(as.matrix(quantTableTrain_scaled[chosenProtsBim,
                                                       trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                         test=t(as.matrix(quantTableTest_scaled[chosenProtsBim,
                                                      testMetaData$Sample_ID])),

                         factor_test=setNames(testMetaData$Site,
                                               testMetaData$Sample_ID)))
mGroup_testData <- list(list(train=t(as.matrix(quantTableTrain_scaled[chosenProtsGrp,
                                                      trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                        test=t(as.matrix(quantTableTest_scaled[chosenProtsGrp,
                                                     testMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                        factor_train=setNames(trainMetaData$Site,
                                              trainMetaData$Sample_ID),
```

#### Test model

```{r}

# If tune parameters
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {
  
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModal_testData,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                    splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                    min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                    max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                    mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = mGroup_testData,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                     splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                     max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                     mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalGrpProts_testData,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             metaData=metaCrossSectional_child,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                             num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                             splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                             min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MinNodeSize,
                                                                                             max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                             mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                         floor(sqrt(length(allChosenProts))),
                                                                                                         bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  # Remove tuned
  gc()
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal)
  rm(lassoResTune_multiGrp)
  rm(lassoResTune_biModal_grpProts)
  gc()
  
# Else use chosen/default parameters
} else {
  
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModal_testData,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    tuneParams = FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = mGroup_testData,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     tuneParams = FALSE))
  
  ## Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalGrpProts_testData,
                                                                                             functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                             thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                             runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                             covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                             importance = "permutation",
                                                                                             local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                             tuneParams = FALSE))

}
```

```{r}

# Calculate metrics
bimMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal,
                                  splitData=biModal_testData,
                                  metaData=testMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=TRUE,
                                  predCol="Site")
grpMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_multiGrp,
                                  splitData=mGroup_testData,
                                  metaData=testMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=TRUE,
                                  predCol="Site")
bimMetrics_grpProts <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal_grpProts,
                                           splitData=biModalGrpProts_testData,
                                           metaData=testMetaData,
                                           multiGroup=TRUE,
                                           predCol="Site")
bimMetrics["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics))
grpMetrics["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(grpMetrics))
bimMetrics_grpProts["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics_grpProts))

# Make tall
bimMetricsTall <- melt(bimMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
grpMetricsTall <- melt(grpMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
bimMetrics_grpProtsTall <- melt(bimMetrics_grpProts,
                                id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
```

#### Plot

```{r}

plotModelMetricsBar <- function(plotData,
                                cols) {

  # Get plots
  plt <- ggplot(plotData,
         aes(x=Group,
             y=value,
             fill=Group)) +
    geom_col() + 
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,
               
               color="darkgrey") +
    facet_grid(cols=vars(variable)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=cols) +
    ylab("Score") + 
    xlab("") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    theme_classic(base_size=16) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
  
  # Return
  return(plt)
  
}

# Get plots
p1 <- plotModelMetricsBar(plotData=bimMetricsTall,
                          cols=siteCols) + 
  ggtitle("Bi-Modal") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.direction="horizontal",
        plot.title=element_text(size=64),
        legend.text=element_text(size=48),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36))   +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                           override.aes = list(size = 25)))
p2 <- plotModelMetricsBar(plotData=grpMetricsTall,
                          cols=siteCols) + 
  ggtitle("Multi-Modal") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.direction="horizontal",

        legend.text=element_text(size=48),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36))   +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                           override.aes = list(size = 25)))
p3 <- plotModelMetricsBar(plotData=bimMetrics_grpProtsTall,
                          cols=siteCols) +
  ggtitle("Bi-Modal (Whole Panel)") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.direction="horizontal",
        plot.title=element_text(size=64),
        legend.text=element_text(size=48),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36))   +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                           override.aes = list(size = 25)))

ggsave(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel",
```
